prompt: Create a high-quality professional overhead product photograph of a whole pepperoni pizza centered on a clean bright white seamless studio background. The pizza should be perfectly round and fill most of the square frame, photographed from directly above with soft studio lighting and a subtle natural shadow around the crust. Show a thin-to-medium golden-brown crust with darker toasted bubbles around the rim, rich red tomato sauce visible near the edges, glossy melted mozzarella cheese with lightly browned spots, fine dried herb seasoning scattered across the cheese, and exactly 21 round pepperoni slices arranged evenly across the surface in a balanced pattern from edge to center. Make the pepperoni deep red-orange, shiny with rendered oil, slightly curled at the edges, and speckled with seasoning. Keep the composition appetizing, realistic, crisp, and commercial-food-photography quality, with no plate, no text, no hands, no props, and no background clutter.

promptZh: 创作一张高质量的专业俯拍产品照片，展示一个完整的意大利辣香肠披萨，置于干净明亮的纯白色无缝摄影棚背景中央。披萨应呈完美的圆形并填满大部分方形画幅，采用正上方视角拍摄，配以柔和的摄影棚灯光，饼皮周围带有细微的自然阴影。饼皮呈现薄至中等的金棕色，边缘有深色的烘烤气泡，边缘处可见浓郁的红色番茄酱，马苏里拉芝士融化后呈现光泽感并带有微焦斑点，芝士上撒有细碎的干香草调料。表面均匀分布着 21 片圆形意大利辣香肠，从边缘到中心呈平衡的排列布局。辣香肠应呈深红橙色，表面泛着油脂光泽，边缘微卷，并带有调料斑点。构图需保持诱人、逼真、清晰，达到商业食品摄影水准，画面中不含餐盘、文字、手部、道具及任何背景杂物。
